text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash, happy birthday! ☆ Anything you<n>want me to
do for you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Consider this a thank-you gift for<n>waking me up
every day—so I'm all<n>ears! ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Anything, you say? Then there is<n>one thing I'd like
to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to write up a thorough daily<n>schedule for
you. As such, I'd like to<n>ask for your sleep hours,
travel time,<n>meal time, training—the works, all<n>down
to the last second.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Th-that might be a little<n>difficult—or even
impossible—for cute<n>lil' Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: S-so... how about this? I'll sing you abirthday song in exactly ten seconds!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I'm sorry, that was einScherz—a joke. You did say anything,so I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wha... Sometimes I really can't<n>tell whether
you're joking or not...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That said, I am interested in hearing<n>your
ten-second birthday song, so if<n>you would.
